senses.gloss: Abhagnaparisaṅkhyāna (No. 3) (whose enumeration or right perception is not interrupted), the “great spirit.” § 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 339, 12864 (Mahāpurushastava).
Abhagnayoga (No. 4) (whose contemplation is not interrupted) = No. 3. XII, 12864.
Ābhāsurāḥ, a class of gods. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 18, 1372.

Abhaya (one of Dhṛtarāshṭra's 100 sons). § 130 (Aṃśāvat.), I, 67, 2739 (the 85th); § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranām.), I, 117, 4551 (the 89th); § 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.), VII, 127, 5178 (attacks Bhīmasena); 5205 (is slain by Bhīmasena).
